customManagers.description: shipyard-cmake's CMake (cmake.pin). No hash to move: build-cmake.sh verifies the tarball against Kitware's own published SHA-256 file, and CI builds it, so a bump is gated on green like any other.
The family toolchain that compiles shipyard-cmake's x86_64/10.9 half (mavericks-clang.pin). CI verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS; a bump rebuilds shipyard-cmake on green.
